page.running_head: De Agro Frisi: inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.p: simul diploma de libertate gentis. Sed &c civitas Groningana, quæ suos quoque homines unà cum sociis legaverat ad eundem Regem, amplissimum diploma Diploma Maximiliani Cā-poduncense, confirmans fœdus O-stergoum.ab eo impetravit, quo fœdus Ostergoum utraque petente parte solenniter confirmatum fuit, præsentibus in aulâ, & nequicquam contra nitentibus Sciringiis. Id diploma datum Campoduni die XXIII[?] Maii: eoque comprehensi quoque illi, qui post perculsum fœdus primum eidem deinde accesserant. At litteræ RegisCam-stræo datæ, viro nobili, in aulâ noto, Regique grato, dissensionem peperêre: dissensio tumultus dedit : per eos istuc de-Foedus novum cum Westergois, Ostergoo fœderi simile.ducta res, ut Bolsuerdia, Worcumum, Stavera, Hindelopa, & maxima nobilitatis Westergoae, maxima item plebis ru-ficae pars foedus novum cum Groninga-nis, foederi Ostergoo similimum, percusserint, denique paulo post tota pene Westergoa, exceptâ FRANEKERA cum conjuratis viris nobilibus, in Grogensium ac sociorum potestatem venerit: quod factum anno Christi M. cccc. XCVI.

page.notes: The marginal note block is set in italic and is given as one note beside the line "ab eo impetravit". Printed hyphens at line ends in the note are kept. "XXIII" in the date is uncertain and marked. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The marginal note in the left margin reads "Foedus novum cum Westergois, Ostergoo fœderi fimile." The "fimile" is printed as "fimile" and corrected here to "simile" as the probable intended word. The printed text has "Grogenfium" and "diffenfio" with long s, which are normalised to plain s. The year "M. cccc. XCVI." appears as printed, with the stop after the M and the final stop after XCVI.
